PM Modi praises coordination after NEET re-exam success

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has commended the successful conduct of the NEET-UG re-examination. He highlighted the importance of coordination between various ministries and a "whole-of-government" approach in achieving this outcome. The re-exam was held following allegations of irregularities in the original test.
